pages.title: Description
pages.text: The Greedy familiar is a Foliot that picks up nearby items directly for its master. Familiar Ring storage is supported, but the Curios pickup-range effect is not available on 1.12.$(br2)$(bold)Upgrade Behaviour$()$(br)After one $()

pages.title: Description
pages.text: Blacksmith upgrade, interact with it while holding a block to set the block type it should locate. Interact again to take the sample block back. It only points to and approaches matching blocks; it never mines them or consumes the sample.$()
